description: Prediction subsystem performance baselines for @wasm4pm/kernel. All times are wall-clock milliseconds measured on a synthetic log (deterministic seed). The regression_threshold_percent field controls how much a future measurement is allowed to exceed the median_ms before a CI alert fires. Baselines were measured on Node.js 22 / Apple M-series hardware; adjust median_ms for your CI environment.

next_activity_fit_n100.description: fit() on 100-trace log, 10 events/trace, 8 activities, ngram order 2

next_activity_fit_n1k.description: fit() on 1000-trace log, 15 events/trace, 12 activities, ngram order 2

next_activity_fit_predict_n100.description: fit_predict() on 100-trace log + 10 prefix traces, prefix length 3

remaining_time_fit_n100.description: fit() on 100-trace log, 10 events/trace, 60s interval, mean aggregator

remaining_time_fit_n1k.description: fit() on 1000-trace log, 15 events/trace, 60s interval, mean aggregator

outcome_fit_predict_n1k.description: fit_predict() on 1000-trace log + prefix traces, prefix length 4

drift_fit_n200.description: fit() on 200-trace log, 10 events/trace, 8 activities, window 50, threshold 0.7

features_fit_n100.description: fit() on 100-trace log, 12 events/trace, 8 activities, rework every 4, with resources

features_fit_predict_n1k.description: fit_predict() on 1000-trace log + prefix traces, prefix length 6, rework enabled

resource_fit_n200.description: fit() on 200-trace log, 10 events/trace, 8 activities, with resources

resource_fit_predict_n200.description: fit_predict() on 200-trace log + 20 prefix traces, prefix length 5

batch_all_6_perspectives_n200.description: executeBatch() — all 6 perspectives, 200-trace log, 200-prefix batch, prefix length 4

next_activity.description: Every scored prefix must return at least one activity candidate

remaining_time.description: Predicted remaining time must be non-negative

outcome.description: Outcome probability distribution must sum to 1 within floating-point tolerance

drift.description: Jaccard similarity in [0,1]; 100% of traces with fully novel activities must be flagged

features.description: Feature vector contains all declared fields with finite numeric values

resource.description: Recommended resource is one of the resources seen during training; all UCB1 scores are non-negative
